4 months ago
I very rarely write reviews, but Sun City has earned these five stars for sure. We needed an air conditioner repair right in the middle of summer (everyone in Las Cruces dreads that). I got impatient and called another company that would come out the next day. They  told me to replace the whole system (only 3.5 years old) after less than 30 seconds looking at it.

Then we got Sun City to come out. Yes, we had to wait a week during the busy season, but it was so so so worth it. Malachi came out, found out what was wrong, got the parts covered under warranty, and repaired everything. During the process it turned out another part needed replaced as well and he took care of that quickly and well too. I feel confident my system is working well and will keep going strong for years.  I will be sticking with Sun City every time from now on.
